snippet.title: After Losing Her Baby, She Went to America to Study Medicine
snippet.description:
After losing her infant son, Anandibai Joshee set out from India to study medicine in America. She wanted to treat women who would not accept care from male physicians.

Follow her journey from a public speech in India to medical college in Pennsylvania, her degree in 1886, and the hospital appointment she hoped to take up on her return.
